text: Leadership uncertainty within the Labour government coincided with accelerated repricing across U.K. sovereign debt markets. Long-duration gilt yields reached multi-decade highs while internal governing coordination and succession pathways remained unresolved. Fisacal expectations, party alignment, and market confidence occupied icnreasingly separated states within the same national financial structure.

meta.note: Governance and financial infrastructure channels overlapped; market repricing functioned as the dominant observable structure.
